defaults.wire_binding: complete_sdk_baseline: capture the same SDK call without hook under fixed clock, IDs, SDK/runtime versions and consumer; bind all SDK-owned defaults, event shape, endpoint, envelope, timestamps and field order from that complete request. Apply only the specified hook edits and contract restoration to that baseline; compare the entire serialized request, preserving every other field. Neutral body is fully expanded for the fixture profile, not a partial field assertion.

node.baseline: capture complete no-hook HTTP request with fixed SDK version, clock, IDs and runtime metadata
node.size_check: existing per-event check where this delivery mode has one
node.sentAt: absent at hook; event sentAt assigned at flush

defaults.comparison: No hook: unchanged complete baseline request. Pass-through hook and other successes: parsed complete JSON values plus endpoint/method and raw payload-marker checks; key order and duplicate-key quirks may differ for pass-through. Never drop baseline fields to compare.

node.drop: same client instance; per-call callback has no arguments

python.drop: instance API: (true, null); module helpers: null

java.drop: submission returns normally; capacity-reporting submission returns false

dotnet.drop: normal return; submission counter unchanged; no delivery callbacks

php.drop: true; delivery error handler not called

ruby.drop: true; delivery error handler not called

ruby-sync.drop: null-equivalent success; no request or delivery error handler
